fluff.overview:
Taurian infantry reflect the Concordat's citizen-soldier tradition, with national service requirements ensuring that most adults have received basic military training before ever donning a uniform. Mechanized tracked platoons trade speed for the all-terrain capability that Taurian commanders need on worlds with rough or undeveloped terrain. Their tracked transports can cross ground that would stop wheeled vehicles, making them reliable assets for garrison duty on frontier worlds where road networks are sparse.

Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these platoons deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
